explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 28 named tracks across two current 2026 releases and three overlooked Kalahari Oyster Cult catalogue releases, plus current label context; attributed descriptions and metadata only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, already retained exact identities and old unresolved leads without materially new identity evidence were excluded.
Reptant — Ballet Robotique and Future Proof were excluded because they remain old unresolved identities; a new review does not itself fix exact Spotify identity resolution.
Leo — Cicada Burnt was excluded because that release lane was already scanned and yielded prior durable results; current praise did not make it fresh.
The listener-protected internal trio handoffs remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and all other boundaries are not protected by implication.
No phrase structure, mixability, perceived pulse, scalar energy, density, space, hypnosis or felt state was invented from metadata or release-level description.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Reptant — To Be Continued...: current minor-key electro with squishy bassline and spidery synths, described as lighter than its surrounding haunted material.
2. SANSIBAR — Fantasmas: begins in electro territory, disintegrates and reforms as contemporary UK techno.
3. SANSIBAR — Scully (Earth People Mix): cavernous breakbeat weight balanced by flamboyance and celestial highs.
4. Junes — Shifting Sands: heads-down techno loosened by sonar pings, acid, reverb and pitch-wheel psychedelia.
5. Cleveland — Golem: sparse skeletal techno with skittering drums and broken melodic material.
6. Blu:sh — Trick Speech: exact current identity retained at the release-evidence floor; individual behaviour unknown.
7. Blu:sh — Full Of Fools: exact current identity retained without title-derived claims.
8. Blu:sh — Red Cocktail (K-Hole Dub): exact current identity; the mix name is not treated as sonic evidence.
9. Blu:sh — Again (Serious Mix): exact current identity; the mix name is not treated as mood or function evidence.
